title: Have you heard of this new Ad Tool, Butter? 🤨
description: Have you heard of this new Ad Tool, Butter? 🤨
transcript: Have you heard of this new ad tool? It solves one of the biggest problems in e commerce right now creative volume. Most brands don't lose because they had bad products, they lose because they can't properly produce and test creatives fast enough. Instant remix. This feature is actually insane. You can take an existing high performing ad template, upload your logo, your product, your brand assets, and butter instantly remixes that creative to match your brand style and voice. So instead of having to constantly design ads from scratch every time, you can generate brand ready creatives in a matter of minutes. That massively speeds up testing, iteration, concept creation, and scaling. No. 2 variations. This is the real unlock. Most brands are still manually making ad variants one by one. Butter lets you instantly generate multiple versions of creative by swapping out the headlines, the hooks, the backgrounds, the images and copy, as well as the layouts. But why does this matter? Because meta rewards iteration speed. The brands winning today are testing way more hooks, more angles, more formats, more creators, and more offers faster than everyone else can. Comment butter and I'll send you the tool.
